newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends off for fifth day running.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends off for fifth day running.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed off at 479.50/480.25 for the fifth day running as the Central Bank continued to let the exchange rate gently slip, traders said.
"The Central Bank carefully monitored the market and supplied enough dollars to feel comfortable with the exchange rate," said one. "A drop of 0.25 bolivars was pretty much expected," he added.
The unit closed Thursday 479.25/480.25 per dollar.
